what: A 180 at moderate speed: steady-state cornering — slip angle, lateral g and the load the outer wheels carry.

A held 0.4 steer entered at high speed: sustained lateral g, yaw rate and how far the heading actually comes round — the moderate-steer-at-speed case the field complains about and no other scene can see.

A corner held entirely on grass: how much less the tyre gets off-road (adhesion group LOOSE is 0.71 of tarmac) and what that does to the line — the only scene the surface-grip change can be judged on.
